high_level_description: This image depicts an urban residential area with a focus on a two-story building. The building is painted in a light beige color and has a flat roof. There are several windows on the upper floor, some of which have blue frames, while others appear to be covered with metal grilles for security. The lower floor features a covered porch supported by white pillars, and there is a brown door with circular patterns near the entrance. In front of the building, there are two motorcycles parked side by side. One motorcycle is black, and the other is blue. Both have license plates attached to them.
